title: HotDay
description: The "Very Hot Day" plugin adds heat to Minecraft, in which players and mobs burn, plants dry out, and food turns into rotten flesh.
body:
## The "Hot Day" plugin adds an atmosphere of extreme heat to Minecraft, which significantly changes the usual course of the game and makes survival in the scorching sun a real challenge.

### When a "very hot day" comes, the following changes occur:

Players and mobs start to burn. Even if they are in the shade, their health begins to decrease rapidly due to the heat. This effect forces players to seek shelter and avoid being outdoors for long periods of time.

The grass turns into earth. The grass, common to most biomes, becomes dry land, giving the world a sense of relentless drought. Bushes, flowers, and other plants disappear, leaving behind only shrubs that look more desiccated.

All the products in the inventory turn into rotten flesh. Any food in the player's inventory is turned into rotten flesh. This not only makes the food unusable, but also pushes players to find alternative food sources such as animals or plants that may still be edible.

It's getting harder for mobs to survive. Due to the heat, many mobs begin to die from overheating, which can significantly affect the domestication of animals or other aspects of interaction with mobs.

The effect extends to all biomes. No matter where the player is, the hot sun affects the whole world, and players need to adapt to these changing conditions in order to survive. In the desert, the heat can become especially dangerous, and in the forests — drought.

The need for shelter and survival. Players will be forced to seek shelter from the sun and come up with ways to cool down, such as wearing special items or using water to protect against overheating. The plugin adds additional complexity and requires players to pay more attention to the environment.

This plugin creates an atmosphere of survival in extreme weather conditions and provides players with new challenges. It is ideal for those who are looking for new ways to test their survival skills and are ready for the real challenges of nature.
